01 / The method & its purpose

Individual context.
Responsible interpretation.

Inspired by EAV principles

EAV stands for Electroacupuncture According to Voll, a methodology developed in the 1950s. Vitastiq PRO applies these principles by recording electrical properties at selected points on the skin.

The application presents indicative, interpretative readings for discussion over time. These readings are not direct measurements of nutrient concentrations in the body.

A platform for lifestyle consultations. Not a medical diagnostic device.Vitastiq PRO does not diagnose, treat or prevent disease, replace laboratory testing, or provide quantitative blood values. Its readings should not be used to establish a nutrient deficiency or make medical treatment decisions.
01 / PREPARE

Start with the client

Open a client profile and follow the application's instructions to prepare the device and session.

02 / RECORD

Follow the guidance

Use the hand electrode and pen at the indicated skin points. No blood sample is required.

03 / DISCUSS

Keep the wider context

Review the report alongside lifestyle and nutrition information. Use recorded history to support follow-up conversations.

04 / Parameters & compatibility

Know what is included.

30 indicative parameters

The parameter set includes vitamins, minerals and other named substances or markers. They are not all vitamins or minerals, and the labels do not mean the device directly measures their levels in the body.
